notes.subject: ילבשו תשועה
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'clothe themselves with salvation' rendered 'put salvation like clothes'; the garment picture is kept.

notes.subject: sekem
notes.rationale: תשועה is rescue/deliverance; Tok Pisin 'sekem' (save) chosen to keep the rescue sense.

notes.subject: olsem klos
notes.rationale: Added to make the clothing metaphor explicit; Hebrew has only the verb 'wrap/wear'.

notes.subject: kirap, Yahwe Elohim
notes.rationale: Solomon's prayer directly summons Yahwe to arise and take His rest.

translation: Na nau, kirap, Yahwe Elohim, long ples bilong malolo bilong yu, yu yet wantaim bokis bilong strong bilong yu; ol pris bilong yu, Yahwe Elohim, bai ol i putim ⟨את⟩ sekem olsem klos, na ol man bilong khesed bilong yu bai ol i hamamas long ol gutpela samting.
